description: This file defines the KycRepository class for managing local storage of KycData, including methods to get, save, and clear KYC data using SharedPreferences.

classes.name: KycRepository
classes.description: Manages local storage of KycData, providing methods to retrieve, save, and clear KYC information.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the stored KycData from local storage, decoding it from a string.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the provided KycData object into local storage after encoding it to a string.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes the stored KycData from local storage.
